adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/groups_controller.rb#members`, pagination params are taken directly from the client: `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i`, then applied as `group.users...limit(limit).offset(offset)`. There is no upper bound on `limit`, so a client can request an arbitrarily large membership list in one query, and `offset` can be negative (e.g. "-10".to_i => -10) and is passed straight into `Relation#offset`, which can yield invalid SQL/DB errors or unintended behavior. This behavior is introduced by the diff (previous logic limited automatic groups and defaulted offset safely).
